exposition.method: Every active archive or record terminal carries relevant, manually paginated exposition. In the Defense Archive, the native ABCD station remains functional-only; five other banks retain repeatable political records, while the southeast bank combines Nuke, Missile Command, and the persistent archive-video player. Its root menu always offers Arcade Games / Video Disk / Leave, and Arcade Games opens Play NUKE / Missile Command / Back. Back restores the root menu, while root Leave immediately restores control without launching a game, checking inventory, or starting playback. Choosing Video Disk then checks the one-time disk pickup at the native center film apparatus. Its seven captioned news frames use Celia Ren only for the newsroom introduction, then move through a restaurant overlooking ration lines, lavish private fallout shelters, nationwide food lines, a wealthy estate burning before a poorer mob, an empty maternity ward amid collapsing birth rates, and a live emergency report of a nuclear launch, retaliation beginning, failing command links, and an immediate shelter warning that ends "This is not a drill." The broadcast does not narrate the exchange's outcome or its own aftermath. The former Miang political report is retired from this reel. In the six paired source-378 lore annexes, both the desk station and hanging computer provide separate, repeatable mail. Target 367 is a native source-377 branch junction; its two optional source-374 dead ends, targets 385 and 386, each place new civil-versus-military launch-program mail on a native hooded computer and keep exposition separate from a one-time Omegasol chest. The Railway and Auxiliary rooms remain deliberate exceptions: the Railway desk station and both Auxiliary floor-console sections operate their mechanical switches, while their separate hanging terminals carry exposition. Dated correspondence follows guidance engineer Lena, her daughter Mira, systems engineer Aron, and payload-safety officer Mara from hopeful survey launches through military conversion, political and economic coercion, Kim's research, and Zeboim's nuclear collapse. All five reserve magazines enter silently and place their existing optional records on the same visible, repeatable east-side field-373 Zeboim station, lowered to stand on the floor. Magazine 02 retains its 6079 mail thread about the civil budget cut, Strategic Command's takeover terms, and an explicit nuclear-warhead manifest. The records use concrete workplace detail and leave most interpretation to the player; Elly and Emeralda provide the dungeon responses. The optional code records remain discoverable clues rather than invisible authorization keys. In Central Control, one entity-13 activation presents Elly's subjective historical memory with only the Launch Director and Systems Officer visible while hidden Miang supplies the POV and offscreen MIANG voice. Optional entity 12 at (136,131) provides only Elly's repeatable observation that the relocated solid compact console looks out of place among the other computer terminals. After present dialogue 32, Citan's native-door arrival continues automatically; he faces Elly for dialogue 35, then visibly operates the keypad under a held camera before Taura's capsule launches locally from target 728. No second Cross/X press is required. Targets 388 and 507 and all Krelian-laboratory assets are absent from the active route.
